snapshot: WHO European Region. Regions run health care; since the September 2026 election a caretaker government is in office while parties try to form a new one. A long-standing leader on antimicrobial resistance.

leadership.role: Minister for Social Affairs and Public Health, incl. medicines (caretaker)
leadership.name: Jakob Forssmed

agenda.title: No new government yet
agenda.text: The centre-left opposition won the 13 September 2026 election by 176 seats to 173 and Prime Minister Kristersson resigned. On 15 October the Riksdag rejected Magdalena Andersson as prime minister; on 24 November the speaker scheduled a vote on Kristersson staying on. Until then ministers act as a caretaker government.

agenda.title: AMR strategy and guaranteed revenue for antibiotics
agenda.text: Sweden adopted a new national AMR strategy for 2026-2035, with the Public Health Agency and the Board of Agriculture leading a national action plan. The Public Health Agency's model guaranteeing a minimum annual revenue for important antibiotics was extended in June 2026, with commitments of up to SEK 44 million for 2027 and 2028, and is to be developed further with Nordic and EU partners.

agenda.title: A bigger state role in health care
agenda.text: The outgoing government started an inquiry into national procurement of specialised care (report due June 2027) and set national principles for what care regions and municipalities must offer. A full state takeover of health care from the 21 regions found little support in the parliamentary committee.

nl.text: Close EU partner. Sweden and the Netherlands are both resource partners of the AMR Multi-Partner Trust Fund and work together in EU AMR cooperation; no separate bilateral health agreement found. Further Dutch links below come from the NPHI Collaboration Map.

timeline.text: Inquiry into national procurement of specialised health care starts.
Public Health Agency commissioned to keep guaranteeing access to key antibiotics.
General election: the opposition wins 176 of 349 seats.
Prime Minister Kristersson resigns; his government stays on as caretaker.
Riksdag rejects Magdalena Andersson as prime minister.
Speaker schedules a vote on Kristersson remaining prime minister.
